description: Open positions (jobs) at the hotels of Corissia Resorts in Crete, as on the career page: title, summary, departments, location (Georgioupolis, Chania), employment type, salary where published, date posted and the page of the position. Newest first. Applications are made only on the page of the position (url), with its form, by the candidate; the connector does not apply and receives no personal data. salary null: the website publishes no salary for that position; salary_note is the note of the career page. API v3.
